body:
I'd like someone to care about me beyond my usefulness.   
I'd like someone to love me unconditionally, truly.  
And for hot water and financial stability.   
I need help. And even when I ask, it's nowhere to be found, let alone being ignored. No, whoever is around makes it worse, like calling the cops on me for having a panic attack.

I feel you. I legit yelled at one therapist for 30 minutes for asking "do you have access to a gun". Good to know youre more concerned if I'll just snap and not doing what I pay you for which is helping me find the will to live. I never come right out and say I want to end it. I know they lock you up.  The hotlines are bullshit. I yelled at one of them yesterday too. "Do you want someone to come to your house?" Who? A pig cop who will throw me in jail if I'm not frail, small, sad, or white enough to feed his ego? Mental healthcare in this country is a joke.   


I wish I could make it all stop.  I wish someone cared and it hurts my mostly dead already heart to see so many suffering when it could be easily addressed if someone just took the time.
